# Nacho Villanúa — Full Profile

This document contains the extended professional profile published on the Nacho Villanúa website. It covers professional experience, technical projects, education, skills, courses, and contact information.

## Profile

Nacho Villanúa is a Robotics and AI engineer focused on building systems that perceive and interact with the real world. His work explores the intersection of robotic systems, software engineering, and Generative AI. He specializes in software for robotic platforms and AI-powered applications, particularly Generative AI and intelligent agents, and also has experience building web interfaces and deploying cloud solutions.

He has worked in research and industrial environments and enjoys challenges that combine mathematical rigor with creative engineering. His experience spans backend and full-stack software development, solution architecture, robotics, AI and data science, cloud deployment, and collaboration with clients and stakeholders.

In October 2026, he delivered a one-off executive masterclass at ISDI in partnership with EY. He is open to conversations about collaborations, technical consulting, and projects involving robotics and AI. The website indicates a typical response time of 24–48 hours.

## Professional Experience

### Robotics Specialist — Alisys

**May 2026–Present**

Responsible for the end-to-end software development of autonomous navigation systems, sensor integration, and field testing for mobile robotic platforms (UGVs and quadrupeds) in critical and industrial environments.

#### Key Projects

- **Autonomous UGV Navigation & Digital Twin:** Designed and developed from scratch the complete outdoor autonomous navigation software stack. Implemented complex sensor fusion using 3D LiDAR (Ouster), Dual-Antenna GNSS RTK, and wheel encoders for high-precision positioning and autonomous docking maneuvers. Built a high-fidelity Digital Twin in Gazebo for realistic simulation and software validation prior to critical 24/7 deployment at a military base.
- **Spot Payload Integration & 3D Scanning:** Integrated a Leica LiDAR payload with Spot CORE on a Boston Dynamics Spot robot, enabling automated 3D point cloud generation and spatial mapping in new construction environments.
- **Extreme Environment Testing:** Conducted field testing and sensory performance evaluation of a quadruped robot (V60) inside a simulated tunnel fire. Analyzed localization stability, thermal drift, and sensor degradation (LiDAR/IMU) under severe smoke and high-temperature conditions to assess operational viability for search and rescue operations.

### Software Developer / AI Engineer — Syntonize | Generative AI Consulting for UNIR (Proeduca)

**July 2025–May 2026**

Designs and architects Generative AI solutions for commercial-process optimization, quality auditing, and automated customer interaction. The application ecosystem uses LangGraph to orchestrate complex agentic workflows and is deployed natively on Microsoft Azure using microservices.

#### Key Projects

- **Predictive Lead Profiling and Real-Time Sales Personalization:** Designed a Generative AI engine to qualify prospective students and improve conversion. LangGraph workflows extract each lead's previous experience, education, and program of interest, estimate underlying interests, and generate tailored sales strategies and personalized messages in real time. Deployed on Azure Web Apps with NoSQL profile storage and bidirectional Salesforce integration through middleware and REST APIs, surfacing predictions directly in advisors' CRM workspace.
- **Intelligent Call Auditing and Large-Scale Analysis:** Developed a LangGraph-based Speech-to-Text and LLM pipeline capable of processing and inspecting **3,000 sales calls per day**. It extracts structured information about students' experience, education, and interests, and evaluates advisors against detailed university sales and quality rubrics. Arize Phoenix records and monitors LLM traces; MLflow and Metabase support prompt versioning and metric dashboards. LLM-as-a-Judge evaluators measure faithfulness, relevance, and rubric adherence against a baseline to assess performance changes.
- **Autonomous Voice and Text Agents for Lead Recovery:** Built conversational agents to re-engage inactive leads who had previously expressed interest in a program. Real-time voice agents combine Deepgram speech recognition, ElevenLabs speech synthesis, and LiveKit over WebRTC for interruption handling, tool calling, and seamless hand-off to a human advisor in Salesforce when a lead signals purchase intent. A WhatsApp agent preserves context for asynchronous follow-up. Adversarial LLM agents simulate erratic, challenging, or ambiguous users to uncover edge cases and improve robustness before production. Deployed on Microsoft Azure Kubernetes clusters, with real-time observability and alerts through Microsoft Teams and Telegram.
- **Generative AI Career Recommendation:** Developed an application that recommends educational programs based on professional trajectories.

### Software Developer, Digital Hub — Acciona

**January 2023–July 2025**

Worked on the design and development of applications that bring emerging technologies into real business solutions. Backend development was the primary role, with contributions to frontend work across projects. Participated throughout the delivery lifecycle: gathering requirements directly from clients, analyzing needs, designing system architectures, planning resources and timelines, developing products, and following up with clients to align delivery and iteratively improve solutions.

#### Robotics

**Manipulation and Collaborative Robots (Cobots)**

- **AI-Powered Waste Sorting (UR3):** Programmed a UR3 collaborative robotic arm for automated pick-and-place tasks. Developed a computer vision pipeline using 3D point-cloud processing and AI classification models to detect, grasp, and sort waste into designated recycling bins.
- **Force-Controlled Surface Sanding (UR10):** Engineered a robotic wall-sanding application using a UR10 cobot equipped with a force-torque sensor and sanding end-effector. Implemented a custom PID control loop to dynamically regulate linear and angular forces for consistent, uniform surface abrasion.
- **Underwater Inspection:** Calibrated and configured remotely operated vehicles (ROVs) for subsea infrastructure inspection and maintenance.

**Autonomous Navigation and Mobile Robots (UGVs & AMRs)**

- **Outdoor Autonomy and Teleoperation (Summit-XL):** Designed and implemented the localization and navigation stack for a Summit-XL UGV. Enabled outdoor autonomy using georeferenced maps and local obstacle avoidance by fusing 2D LiDAR, RTK-GPS, and IMU through Kalman filters and AMCL. Developed a custom web GUI using WebRTC and WebSockets for low-latency remote teleoperation and autonomous mission generation.
- **Campus-Wide Disinfection (MiR):** Deployed a Mobile Industrial Robot (MiR) across the Acciona corporate campus for automated workspace disinfection. Managed large-scale environment mapping, route optimization, and semantic definition of restricted and preferred navigation zones.

**Service Platforms and Quadrupeds**

- **Hospitality Automation:** Programmed and deployed Pudu Robotics service platforms (KettyBot and BellaBot) in the campus restaurant for automated food delivery and autonomous customer interaction.
- **Industrial Inspection:** Operated and deployed Boston Dynamics Spot for client demonstrations at major public events and inspection routines in high-risk corporate zones.

#### Generative AI, Agents, and Data Science

**Data Science and Predictive Modeling**

- **Public Tender Optimization (Abnormally Low Bids):** Developed a predictive system to optimize bidding strategies and forecast abnormally low bids. Combined Monte Carlo simulations for scenario planning, KNN to identify historically similar tenders, NLP embeddings for semantic analysis of tender documents, and a neural network to predict the exact number of competitors. Its prediction accuracy exceeded Acciona's internal baseline. Integrated the model into a Django web application for parameter adjustment and scenario exploration.
- **Computer Vision for Infrastructure:** Trained a TensorFlow convolutional neural network (CNN) on annotated image datasets to automatically detect and classify road-surface cracks, streamlining civil infrastructure inspections.

**Generative AI and Intelligent Agents**

- **Multimodal Document Ingestion:** Built an unstructured-document pipeline for PDFs, Word documents, Excel spreadsheets, PowerPoint presentations, and images. Used OCR and YOLO for multimodal transcription, table detection, and visual-element extraction. Generated summaries and semantic embeddings, orchestrated through asynchronous Celery microservices.
- **Agentic RAG with Human-in-the-Loop:** Developed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture driven by autonomous agents with Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) capabilities. Agents formulate and execute SQL queries against structured databases, reformulate complex questions, disambiguate intent, transparently cite data sources, and handle overlapping or conflicting references.
- **Knowledge Graph Inconsistency Detection:** Designed a semantic inconsistency-detection algorithm for large corporate document collections. Leveraged Knowledge Graphs and hierarchical document relationships for multi-level comparisons to identify contradictions and overlapping clauses across legal and technical texts.
- **Local LLM Fine-Tuning:** Fine-tuned DeepSeek models locally using LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) and quantization to optimize performance and inference speed on constrained hardware. Extracted evaluation metrics from RAG systems and deployed solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

## Education

### Master's Degree in Robotics and Automation — Universidad Carlos III de Madrid

**2023**

Advanced study in intelligent control, machine learning, computer vision, medical robotics, humanoids, and mobile robotics, with a focus on medical robotics and human–robot collaboration.

**Master's thesis: “Simultaneous Localization and Mapping and Segmentation”**

Focused on mobile robotics and spatial understanding. Developed a SLAM algorithm that generated 2D and 3D maps using point-cloud registration methods including ICP and NDT, integrated through pose graphs.

Technical contributions:

- SLAM algorithm for 2D and 3D map generation.
- Point-cloud registration using ICP and NDT.
- Pose graphs for trajectory optimization.
- Door and room segmentation using watershed algorithms.
- Multi-method fusion for robust detection.
- Topological map generation from geometric data.

### Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Technologies Engineering — Universidad de Málaga

**2021**

Multidisciplinary engineering education covering mechanics, structural analysis, electrical systems, thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, and control theory. The program emphasized analytical thinking, problem-solving, and modeling complex systems. Specialization in automation and electronics included industrial and collaborative robotics, computer vision, digital and analog electronics, and machine learning and deep learning for intelligent systems.

**Bachelor's thesis: “Human-Robot Collaboration Strategy in Endonasal Surgery”**

Part of the National Research Plan project “Global Planner for a Robotic System for Anastomosis.” The work contributed to the publication “Collaborative Robotic Assistant Platform for Endonasal Surgery: Preliminary In-Vitro Trials.” The CRANEEAL system combines two robotic arms (one autonomous and one teleoperated through a haptic interface), force sensors, and a ROS-based software architecture.

Technical contributions:

- Designed a virtual-obstacle generation module to improve surgical safety through force feedback and collision avoidance.
- Developed a camera-calibration setup using a custom 3D-printed calibration piece to map between 3D environments and 2D vision.
- Implemented an ontology-based state machine for switching between autonomous and teleoperated modes using computer vision and Markov models.
- Integrated modules within a ROS software architecture.
- Built a web interface for real-time system monitoring and control of autonomous and manual functions.
